items.title: Derivation of third Equation of Motion by Graphical method (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Derivation of third Equation of Motion by Graphical method: a main subheading of 2.4 Equations of motion, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 28-33.

blocks.text: Speed-time graph mein body ka total distance S graph ke neeche ka area OABD hai. Yeh shape trapezium hai, jis ka area = ½ × (parallel sides ka sum) × height:

blocks.text_alt: S = ½(Sum of parallel sides) × Height

blocks.latex: \text{Since}\quad OA = v_i,\ BD = v_f \ \text{and}\ OD = t
blocks.text_alt: Since OA = vi, BD = vf and OD = t

blocks.text: To upar wali equation yeh ban jati hai:

blocks.alt: Velocity-time graph. Seedhi line AB velocity axis ke point A (OA = vi) se B (BD = vf) tak charhti hai. Dashed lines E se B, A se C (length t) aur B se C ke raste time axis par D tak; BD ke saath double arrow vf dikhata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 2.7: Velocity-time graph (kitab ki Figure 2.7 ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.text: Yahi teesri equation of motion hai.

Equations of motion straight line mein uniform acceleration wali motion ke sawal hal karne mein kaam aati hain. Agar motion ki direction na badle to sab vector quantities ko scalars ki tarah add-subtract kar sakte hain. Aise mein initial velocity ko positive lete hain, aur jo quantity us ki ulti direction mein ho use negative sign dete hain. Air resistance (hawa ki rukawat) na ho to Zameen ki surface ke paas free fall (khud girti) har cheez Zameen ki taraf ek hi uniform acceleration se aati hai. Ise acceleration due to gravity kehte hain, g se likhte hain, aur Zameen ki surface par is ki average value 9.8 m s⁻² neeche ki taraf li jati hai. Free fall par bhi yahi equations lagti hain; bas a ki jagah g likh dein.

blocks.title: Example 2.2
blocks.problem: 10 m s⁻¹ se chalti car 2 m s⁻² ke uniform acceleration se accelerate hoti (tez hoti) hai. 5 s baad us ki velocity nikalein.
steps: Given: vi = 10 m s⁻¹, a = 2 m s⁻², t = 5 s; maloom karna hai vf.
vf = 10 m s⁻¹ + 2 m s⁻² × 5 s

blocks.title: Example 2.3
blocks.problem: Car 15 m s⁻¹ ki initial velocity se chalti hai aur 4 seconds tak 2 m s⁻² ke rate se accelerate hoti hai. Car ka displacement nikalein.
steps: Given: vi = 15 m s⁻¹, a = 2 m s⁻², t = 4 s; maloom karna hai S.
Values rakhein: S = (15 m s⁻¹ × 4 s) + ½(2 m s⁻²)(4 s)²

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne values rakhte waqt (16 s)² likha hai; sahi (4 s)² = 16 s² hai. Kitab ka answer 76 m sahi hai, kyun ke calculation mein 16 s² hi istemal hua hai.

blocks.title: Example 2.4
blocks.problem: Short distance (chhote faasle) ki race mein car rest (ruki hui halat) se chalti hai aur constant acceleration se 0.45 km tay kar ke 300 km h⁻¹ ki velocity tak pohanchti hai. Yeh acceleration nikalein.
steps: Given: vi = 0, vf = 300 km h⁻¹, S = 0.45 km.
km h⁻¹ ko m s⁻¹ mein badlein (1 km = 1000 m, 1 h = 60 × 60 s): vf = (300 × 1000)/(60 × 60) m s⁻¹ = 250/3 m s⁻¹ ≈ 83.3 m s⁻¹

blocks.caption: Teen equations of motion (ek nazar mein)
rows: BD = BC + OA; line AB ka slope = a
trapezium OABD ka area, t = (vf - vi)/a rakh kar

blocks.prompt: Ek train 30 m s⁻¹ se chal rahi hai aur 600 m mein uniform taur par ruk jati hai. Us ki deceleration (speed kam hone ka rate) aur laga hua time nikalein. Har ek ke liye kaun si equation lagegi, aur acceleration negative kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Teesri equation: 2aS = vf² - vi², to a = (0 - 900)/(2 × 600) = -0.75 m s⁻². Pehli equation: t = (vf - vi)/a = (0 - 30)/(-0.75) = 40 s. Initial velocity ko positive lete hain; train dheemi ho rahi hai, is liye acceleration ulti direction mein hai aur us par negative sign aata hai.

items: Constant a se straight line motion: vf = vi + at; S = vit + ½at²; 2aS = vf² - vi². Graph se: v-t line ka slope = a, aur graph ke neeche ka area = S (rectangle + triangle, ya trapezium).
Initial velocity positive, ulti direction wali quantities negative; free fall mein a ki jagah g = 9.8 m s⁻² neeche ki taraf. Examples ke answers: 20 m s⁻¹; 76 m; 7.72 m s⁻².
